recognize_zh: 左圖周邊血中的淋巴球細胞質邊緣呈細毛狀突起（hairy projections），右圖骨髓切片中細胞核彼此間隔均勻、周圍有清亮細胞質（fried-egg 外觀），兩者合起來是毛細胞白血病（HCL）的典型表現。
features: PB: medium-sized lymphoid cell with circumferential fine hair-like cytoplasmic projections
PB: round to oval nucleus with homogeneous chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm; a second smaller lymphoid cell nearby
BM biopsy: interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval/bean-shaped nuclei widely spaced by clear cytoplasm (fried-egg appearance)
BM biopsy: residual marrow fat with sparse normal hematopoiesis in the field
Background red cells show mild poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, homogeneous chromatin, and moderate pale cytoplasm bearing fine circumferential hair-like projections. The accompanying bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of cells with oval and bean-shaped nuclei separated by abundant clear cytoplasm, imparting a fried-egg appearance, with little residual normal hematopoiesis in the field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia, supported clinically by pancytopenia and splenomegaly; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123, annexin A1) and/or BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have prominent nucleoli, cause leukocytosis without monocytopenia, and are CD25/annexin A1 negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short projections and show intrasinusoidal/nodular marrow involvement, lacking CD103/CD25/annexin A1 co-expression.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows broad-based villi and intrasinusoidal marrow infiltration, and is CD25 and annexin A1 negative.
Mast cells in marrow also have clear cytoplasm but form paratrabecular spindled aggregates with fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117 positive.
